changelog:
- Browser Privacy Routing: Clean custom SOCKS and HTTP proxy routing with fail-closed safeguards.
- Resilient Background Media: Precision media tracking and keep-alive service preventing paused media or ads from resuming.
- Enhanced Video PiP: Full ancestor hierarchy isolation ensuring clean video playback in Picture-in-Picture.
- Public IP Comparison: Verify browser exit IP versus direct device IP.
- Desktop Privacy Routing: Live health monitor, session proxy synchronization, and fail-closed leak prevention.
